name: Marilyn Strickland
bio: a Representative from Washington; born in Seoul, South Korea, September 25, 1962; graduated from Mount Tahoma High School, Tacoma, Wash., 1980; B.A., University of Washington, Seattle, Wash., 1984; M.B.A., Clark Atlanta University, Atlanta, Ga., 1992; marketing executive; member of the Tacoma, Wash., city council, 2008-2009; Mayor of Tacoma, Wash., 2010-2017; president and CEO, Seattle (Wash.) Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce, 2018-2019; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
